主要内容: On March 7, 2017, Joshua Bekenstein, a director of Waters Corporation, notified the company of his decision to resign as a director, effective immediately. This resignation is a corporate governance event affecting the board of directors of the company. The event is reported in a Form 8-K filing with the SEC, dated March 13, 2017. The resignation does not provide specific details about the reasons or implications for the company's operations or financial performance. The filing is signed by Sherry L. Buck, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Waters Corporation, on behalf of the registrant.
